info.description: Operational read-out for the Caravea Connect dealer sync: when it last ran, whether it worked, and what it did. Admin panel only — there is deliberately no controller, service or route folder here, so this single type has no public content API and no Settings → Roles checkbox. CREDENTIALS ARE NOT HERE and must never be added: CONNECT_API_URL / CONNECT_API_KEY live in the server .env. Putting operational secrets in the database is what armed real SMTP against real dealer addresses when a live data.db was copied down for local work.

connectSyncEnabled.description: Second, in-database guard. The MASTER switch is CONNECT_SYNC_ENABLED in the server .env, which is what gates the cron registration itself; this only lets an admin stop the sync on one environment without a deploy. Both must be on for a sweep to run.
